answer: To resist Sybil attacks, a validator committee emits a beacon to audit interaction subgraphs across an execution thread. Auditors perform topological cut verifications, requiring clustered nodes to prove cross-cluster connectivity. If a cut reveals synthetic partitioning, agents lose their deposited stake. Colluding clusters face superlinear attacker cost scaling as O(N^2) required capital, while honest nodes propagate a verifiable cryptographic signal.
